questions.stem: At Harbor Health, which workspace role gives the engineers what they need with the least privilege?
questions.explanation: Contributors can create, edit and delete items but can't manage access. Members can also share and add people, and Admins can do everything, which is more than the engineers need.

questions.stem: Which is the only workspace role that can delete the workspace?
questions.explanation: Only Admins can delete the workspace and add or remove other Admins.

questions.stem: A user must view the workspace's content but change nothing. Which workspace role fits?
questions.explanation: Viewers can see and use content without editing it.

questions.stem: Which three can be given a Fabric workspace role? Each correct answer is a complete solution.
questions.explanation: Workspace roles are assigned to users and groups, including security groups and Microsoft 365 groups. Items can't hold workspace roles.

questions.stem: A user with the Contributor role wants to share a report from the workspace with a colleague outside it. What lets them do this without changing their workspace role?

options.text: The Build permission on the semantic model
Nothing; only Admins can share items

questions.explanation: Admins and Members can share items. Contributors and Viewers can also share an item if they have Reshare permission on it.

questions.stem: A team lead must add new engineers to the workspace and share its content, but must not be able to delete the workspace or add Admins. Which role fits?
questions.explanation: Members can add people with lower permissions and share content. Only Admins can delete the workspace and add or remove other Admins.

questions.stem: Only one person should be able to create a workspace identity for a workspace. Which role must that person have?
questions.explanation: Creating a workspace identity is an Admin-only capability.

questions.stem: An operator must start and cancel pipeline runs and notebook runs in a workspace but shouldn't share content or manage people. What is the least role?
questions.explanation: Contributors can execute and cancel pipelines and notebooks. Viewers can only see execution output, and Members can also share.

questions.stem: Marta has the Viewer role in a workspace and was also given direct access to one of its reports. You remove her item permission on the report, but she can still open it. Why?

options.text: Reports can't have item permissions removed
Item permissions take up to a week to expire
She has a cached copy of the report
Her Viewer role still gives access to all content in the workspace

questions.explanation: Workspace roles apply to every item in the workspace. To stop her viewing the report, you also have to remove her Viewer role.

questions.stem: Which two can a user with the Viewer workspace role do? Each correct answer is a complete solution.

options.text: Read lakehouse data through Spark and the OneLake APIs
View the execution output of pipelines and notebooks
Connect to the SQL analytics endpoint of a lakehouse

questions.explanation: Viewers can connect to SQL analytics endpoints and see execution output. Reading through Spark or OneLake APIs, running pipelines and subscribing to OneLake events need Contributor or higher.
